topic: Staging vs Production traffic discrepancy analysis
summary_markdown:
A discussion arose regarding discrepancies in traffic data between the staging and production environments, specifically when analyzing frequency metrics for Brazil. The difference was noted to be minor but appeared when selecting a 30-day period (while 1-day and 7-day periods matched). [p1] provided an updated SQL script using `getFrequency_2_stage` instead of `getFrequency_2`, and set `ua_c` as a parameter. It was suggested that the cause of the staging/production difference might be similar to previous discussions.

[me] advised that investigating this requires dedicated time, but [p1] confirmed it was not critical and asked if a task should be created.
decisions: A ticket will be created to investigate the discrepancy between staging and production traffic data.
action_items: [p1] to create a task/ticket regarding the analytics data discrepancy.
